## Productized Commercial Mandates & Advisory Tiers
1. **14-Day Remote Spend & Telemetry Diagnostic (€5,500 fixed sprint)**
   - Audit of procurement spend variance, supplier contract redundancies, and CMMS telemetry downtime logs.
   - 100% Fee Credit Guarantee: If less than €16,500 in annual recovery is identified, 100% of the €5,500 is credited toward an On-Site Audit or Retainer.
2. **5-Day Physical Plant Gemba & Quality Audit (€5,400 sprint + corporate travel)**
   - Physical gemba walks, bottleneck analysis, gage R&R / torque calibration, scrap reduction, and empirical 8D containment roadmap.
3. **Fractional Direct Sourcing & Systems Director (€8,500 / month)**
   - 2 Days/Week equivalent, async-first executive steering. Direct international factory negotiations (China, India, LatAm), CMMS governance (PostgreSQL/MSSQL), and ERP automation.

## Core Industrial Track Record
- **Direct Sourcing & Disintermediation**: Directed $800,000 USD/year portfolio (20 containers/quarter from China & India), achieving up to 75% cost reduction by bypassing intermediaries and deploying bilingual on-site inspection teams (PSI/CLI).
- **Automotive OEM Moving Line (VDL Nedcar)**: Quality inspection of 110–120 BMW and MINI vehicles/shift. Reduced recurrent assembly defects by 15% through digital torque calibration and MES defect logging.
- **High-Tech Assembly Discipline (HQ Pack / KMWE)**: Electromechanical assembly under ISO Class 5 cleanroom conditions, TÜV winch overhaul, and ISAH ERP governance (assembly/repair discipline; not a cleanroom auditor/builder).
- **Modular Housing & Industrial Manufacturing**: Workstation balancing, scrap reduction, and factory-gate component procurement for modular construction (e.g. Almussafes / inHAUS / Cecotec industrial scale).
